questions.q: Which tag is the root element?
questions.qAf: Watter etiket is die wortelelement?
questions.explain: <html> holds everything.
questions.explainAf: <html> bevat alles.

questions.q: Which code centres a paragraph?
questions.qAf: Watter kode sentreer 'n paragraaf?
questions.explain: align="center".
questions.explainAf: align="center".

questions.q: What colour is #0000FF?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is #0000FF?
questions.explain: No red, no green, full blue.
questions.explainAf: Geen rooi, geen groen, volle blou.

questions.q: Which formula adds the prices in A3 to A20?
questions.qAf: Watter formule tel die pryse in A3 tot A20 bymekaar?
questions.explain: SUM adds; COUNT counts how many.
questions.explainAf: SUM tel bymekaar; COUNT tel hoeveel.

questions.q: Planning a fun day by splitting it into food, games and tickets is…
questions.qAf: Om 'n pretdag te beplan deur dit in kos, speletjies en kaartjies op te deel, is…
questions.explain: Breaking a problem into parts.
questions.explainAf: Om 'n probleem in dele op te breek.

questions.q: A car dashboard shows speed and fuel, not every wire. This is…
questions.qAf: 'n Motor se paneelbord wys spoed en brandstof, nie elke draad nie. Dit is…
questions.explain: Leaving out detail.
questions.explainAf: Om besonderhede uit te laat.

questions.q: Why must an algorithm for a robot be precise?
questions.qAf: Hoekom moet 'n algoritme vir 'n robot presies wees?
optionsAf: Robotte kan nie stappe herhaal nie
questions.explain: Vague steps cause errors.
questions.explainAf: Vae stappe veroorsaak foute.

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in die patroon 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, …?

questions.q: A motor must turn at one-third speed. Which PWM value is correct?
questions.qAf: 'n Motor moet teen een derde van sy spoed draai. Watter PWM-waarde is korrek?

questions.q: What is the difference between digital and analog control of a motor?
questions.qAf: Wat is die verskil tussen digitale en analoë beheer van 'n motor?
options: Digital is only off (0 V) or fully on (5 V); analog gives a range (0 to 255)
Analog is only on or off
optionsAf: Digitaal is net af (0 V) of heeltemal aan (5 V); analoog gee 'n reeks (0 tot 255)
Analoog is net aan of af
questions.explain: Analog control gives finer control of speed.
questions.explainAf: Analoë beheer gee fyner beheer oor spoed.

questions.q: What is the recommended input voltage through the barrel jack?
questions.qAf: Wat is die aanbevole insetspanning deur die kragaansluiting?
questions.explain: The board itself works at 5 V.
questions.explainAf: Die bord self werk teen 5 V.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: A syntax error stops the compiler, so no .class file is created.
questions.qAf: 'n Sintaksfout stop die samesteller, dus word geen .class-lêer geskep nie.
questions.explain: Fix the error first, then compile again.
questions.explainAf: Maak eers die fout reg en stel dan weer saam.

questions.q: Using a loop for a command that repeats is an example of pattern recognition.
questions.qAf: Om 'n lus te gebruik vir 'n opdrag wat herhaal, is 'n voorbeeld van patroonherkenning.
questions.explain: Spotting the repeat is pattern recognition.
questions.explainAf: Om die herhaling raak te sien, is patroonherkenning.

questions.q: A small DC motor may be powered straight from an Arduino pin.
questions.qAf: 'n Klein GS-motor mag direk deur 'n Arduino-pen aangedryf word.
questions.explain: A pin gives at most 40 mA; a motor needs about 400 mA. Use an L293D.
questions.explainAf: 'n Pen gee hoogstens 40 mA; 'n motor het sowat 400 mA nodig. Gebruik 'n L293D.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each comment in column A with the language it is written in, in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke kommentaar in kolom A by die taal waarin dit geskryf is, in kolom B.
questions.explain: Java single-line comments start with //, HTML comments are <!-- -->, and CSS comments are /* */. Excel was not one of the three.
questions.explainAf: Java-eenreël-kommentaar begin met //, HTML-kommentaar is <!-- -->, en CSS-kommentaar is /* */. Excel was nie een van die drie nie.

questions.q: Match each chart in column A with what it is in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke grafiek in kolom A by wat dit is in kolom B.
pairs: Like a pie chart, with a hole in the middle
pairsAf: Soos 'n sirkelgrafiek, met 'n gat in die middel
questions.explain: The extra description is a histogram.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing is 'n histogram.

questions.q: An automatic night light: match each part in column A with its place in the IPO model in column B.
questions.qAf: 'n Outomatiese naglig: pas elke deel in kolom A by sy plek in die IPO-model in kolom B.
pairs: Read the light level from the LDR
pairsAf: Lees die ligvlak van die LDR
questions.explain: Read (input) → decide (process) → act (output).
questions.explainAf: Lees (inset) → besluit (verwerking) → reageer (uitset).

sections.title: Missing syntax
sections.intro: Type the missing symbol or word in each box.
sections.introAf: Tik die simbool of woord wat ontbreek in elke blokkie.

questions.q: Type the two braces missing from this loop.
questions.qAf: Tik die twee krulhakies wat in hierdie lus ontbreek.
questions.explain: A block opens with { and closes with }.
questions.explainAf: 'n Blok begin met { en eindig met }.

questions.q: Type the two symbols missing from this link.
questions.qAf: Tik die twee simbole wat in hierdie skakel ontbreek.
questions.explain: Attributes are name="value", and a closing tag has /.
questions.explainAf: Attribute is name="value", en 'n sluitetiket het /.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the steps for modelling a bowl with Revolve in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om 'n bak met Revolve te modelleer, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Create a sketch on a plane
Draw half the outline on one side of the axis, closed and fully constrained
Revolve the sketch 360° around the axis
stepsAf: Teken die helfte van die buitelyn aan een kant van die as, geslote en volledig beperk
Draai die skets 360° om die as (Revolve)
questions.explain: Revolve spins half an outline around an axis, like a potter's wheel.
questions.explainAf: Revolve draai die helfte van 'n buitelyn om 'n as, soos 'n pottebakkerswiel.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenarioAf: Ayesha se program gebruik hierdie veranderlikes:

questions.q: What does the last line print?
questions.qAf: Wat druk die laaste reël?
questions.explain: + joins the text and the value.
questions.explainAf: + voeg die teks en die waarde saam.

questions.q: What does the + do here?
questions.qAf: Wat doen die + hier?
questions.explain: Concatenation joins strings.
questions.explainAf: Aaneenskakeling voeg stringe saam.

questions.q: Which variable stores a decimal?
questions.qAf: Watter veranderlike stoor 'n desimale getal?
questions.explain: height is a double.
questions.explainAf: height is 'n double.

questions.scenario: Musa writes this program for his Gogga, bee.
questions.scenarioAf: Musa skryf hierdie program vir sy Gogga, bee.

questions.q: How many times does bee.move() run?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer word bee.move() uitgevoer?
questions.explain: Two moves each time × 4 times = 8.
questions.explainAf: Twee bewegings elke keer × 4 keer = 8.

questions.q: How many times does bee turn right?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer draai bee regs?
questions.explain: turnRight() is after the loop, so it runs once.
questions.explainAf: turnRight() is ná die lus, dus loop dit een keer.

questions.q: How many times does the loop run?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer loop die lus?
questions.explain: counter 0, 1, 2, 3: 4 times.
questions.explainAf: counter 0, 1, 2, 3: 4 keer.

questions.q: bee.turnRight() is inside the loop.
questions.qAf: bee.turnRight() is binne die lus.
questions.explain: It comes after the closing }.
questions.explainAf: Dit kom ná die sluitende }.

questions.scenario: Thandeka's exchange rate (R18) is in D1 and dollar prices are in A3:A20. In B3 she types =A3*D1 and copies it down.
questions.scenarioAf: Thandeka se wisselkoers (R18) is in D1 en die dollarpryse is in A3:A20. In B3 tik sy =A3*D1 en kopieer dit af.

questions.q: What happens in B4?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur in B4?
questions.explain: Both relative references move down; D2 is empty.
questions.explainAf: Albei relatiewe verwysings skuif af; D2 is leeg.

questions.q: Type the symbols that lock D1.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbole wat D1 sluit.
questions.explain: $D$1 locks column and row.
questions.explainAf: $D$1 sluit kolom en ry.

questions.q: She names D1 Rate in the Name Box. Which formula uses it?
questions.qAf: Sy noem D1 Rate in die Name Box. Watter formule gebruik dit?
questions.explain: A named range is used like a cell reference.
questions.explainAf: 'n Benoemde reeks word soos 'n selverwysing gebruik.

questions.scenario: Lindiwe draws a line freely, then adds a vertical and a horizontal distance constraint to one of its end points.
questions.scenarioAf: Lindiwe teken 'n lyn vry en voeg dan 'n vertikale en 'n horisontale afstandbeperking by een van sy eindpunte.

questions.q: How many DOF does the line have left?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel DOF het die lyn nog?
questions.explain: 4 − 2 = 2 (length and angle are still free).
questions.explainAf: 4 − 2 = 2 (lengte en hoek is nog vry).

questions.q: She adds a length and an angle constraint. What is the sketch now?
questions.qAf: Sy voeg 'n lengte- en 'n hoekbeperking by. Wat is die skets nou?
questions.explain: Zero DOF: fully constrained.
questions.explainAf: Nul DOF: volledig beperk.

questions.q: She then adds another length constraint to the same line. What happens?
questions.qAf: Sy voeg dan nog 'n lengtebeperking by dieselfde lyn. Wat gebeur?
questions.explain: Too many constraints conflict.
questions.explainAf: Te veel beperkings bots.

questions.q: Why should every sketch be fully constrained?
questions.qAf: Hoekom moet elke skets volledig beperk wees?
options: It cannot shift by accident, so the model is accurate
optionsAf: Dit kan nie per ongeluk skuif nie, dus is die model akkuraat
questions.explain: The model is identical every time it is opened.
questions.explainAf: Die model is elke keer dieselfde wanneer dit oopgemaak word.

questions.scenario: Musa connects an LED straight to pin 13 and GND without a resistor, and it stops working.
questions.scenarioAf: Musa koppel 'n LED direk aan pen 13 en GND sonder 'n resistor, en dit hou op werk.

questions.q: Why did it stop working?
questions.qAf: Hoekom het dit opgehou werk?
options: Too much current flowed and it burnt out
optionsAf: Te veel stroom het gevloei en dit het uitgebrand
questions.explain: An LED has very low internal resistance.
questions.explainAf: 'n LED het baie lae interne weerstand.

questions.q: The pin gives 5 V, the LED drops 2 V, and he wants 12 mA (0.012 A). Which resistor?
questions.qAf: Die pen gee 5 V, die LED se spanningsval is 2 V, en hy wil 12 mA (0,012 A) hê. Watter resistor?

questions.q: Which LED leg goes to GND?
questions.qAf: Watter LED-been gaan na GND?
questions.explain: Anode to the resistor, cathode to GND.
questions.explainAf: Anode na die resistor, katode na GND.

questions.q: How is an ammeter connected?
questions.qAf: Hoe word 'n ammeter gekoppel?
questions.explain: A voltmeter goes in parallel.
questions.explainAf: 'n Voltmeter gaan in parallel.
